verdict.rationale: Flagright's Management API documents a case status-update endpoint. It accepts CLOSED and REOPENED statuses, plus custom statuses, and alerts can be set to CLEARED. That supports resolving and reopening decisions. However, nothing in the pack shows an audit record or history attached to these changes, and there is no explicit false-positive disposition or override flow. Missing for 10: audit trail/history of status changes, explicit false-positive resolution reason, decision override mechanism, hands-on or independent corroboration.
